title: A sender that dies halfway
request:
Process 0 broadcasts, one process gets it, then 0 crashes

./your_program.sh broadcast
init 3
mode best-effort
broadcast 0
hand 1 1
crash 0
settle
delivered 1
note: Nothing went wrong that best-effort broadcast promised would not happen. Two correct processes now disagree about whether the message exists, which is fine until something is built on top that assumes they agree.

title: The same run, one mode stronger
request:
The identical sequence under reliable broadcast

./your_program.sh broadcast
init 3
mode reliable
broadcast 0
hand 1 1
crash 0
settle
delivered 1
note: The sender is just as dead. What changed is that delivery now means "I will make sure everyone else gets this too", so the broadcast is completed by its recipients. That is the whole implementation: relay on first delivery.
